journey.name: Connect Claude API key
journey.description: Opens Settings and reaches the Claude API key entry sheet, verifying the key field and connect action. Start state: fresh install with no API key configured. Stops before entering a real key.

actions.action: Tap the "SETTINGS" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
Verify the Settings screen shows a "Claude API Key" row with the subtitle "Required for AI features".
Verify the "Connect Claude AI" sheet is shown with an API key input field and a "Save & Connect" button.
Verify the "Save & Connect" button is disabled while the key field is empty.
